description: This file defines the X509Util class, providing utility functions for handling Android's X.509 certificates, trust management, and certificate verification within the Chromium project.

classes.name: X509Util
classes.description: Utility class for managing Android's X.509 certificates, trust managers, and certificate verification processes.

classes.name: TrustStorageListener
classes.description: Inner class extending BroadcastReceiver to listen for keystore changes and trigger trust manager reloads.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes trust managers and certificate factory if not already initialized.

methods.name: ensureInitializedLocked
methods.description: Performs initialization with lock held; sets up trust managers, keystore, and broadcast receiver.

methods.name: createTrustManager
methods.description: Creates an X509TrustManagerExtensions backed by a specified KeyStore.

methods.name: reloadTestTrustManager
methods.description: Reloads the trust manager used for testing after modifications to the test keystore.

methods.name: reloadDefaultTrustManager
methods.description: Reloads the default system trust manager after system keystore changes.

methods.name: createCertificateFromBytes
methods.description: Converts DER-encoded bytes into an X509Certificate object.

methods.name: addTestRootCertificate
methods.description: Adds a test root certificate to the test keystore and reloads trust manager.

methods.name: clearTestRootCertificates
methods.description: Clears all test root certificates and reloads trust manager.

methods.name: hashPrincipal
methods.description: Generates a hash of an X500Principal for trust anchor identification.

methods.name: isKnownRoot
methods.description: Checks if a given X509Certificate is a known system trust root.

methods.name: verifyKeyUsage
methods.description: Verifies if a certificate's Extended Key Usage extension contains valid OIDs for server auth.

methods.name: getUserAddedRoots
methods.description: Returns DER-encoded list of user-added root certificates.

methods.name: verifyServerCertificates
methods.description: Verifies server certificate chain against trust managers and checks validity.
